note: Alberta Parks campground in William A. Switzer Provincial Park, about 22 km north-west of Hinton off Hwy 40 on a paved access road: treed sites next to Jarvis Lake with a playground, trails, pier and hand launch; beach, boat launch and dock at the nearby day-use area. Bring water. Sani-dump (fee) and showers at Gregg Lake Campground; firewood at the Visitor Centre and the Gregg Lake booth in peak season. --Claude

Lakeview kept (sites at the clearing by the pier, ~25-40 m from the water). Phone 1-877-537-2757 found.

Most other sites sit 40-120 m back under canopy (no view confirmable). Lakeview holds for the few sites at the clearing; not lakefront (the clearing/pier access lies between). If the reviewer wants every site, downgrade to not waterfront.
